name: Clipboard
description:
The Clipboard component provides an accessible way to copy text to the user's clipboard with built-in visual feedback.

It is unstyled by default: every part accepts Panda style props, `css` and `asChild`, so you can turn the trigger into a button or the input into a text field. Use `Clipboard.CopyIndicator` or `Clipboard.CopyText` inside the trigger for the default copy/copied feedback, or `Clipboard.TriggerWithTooltip` to show that status in a tooltip.

parts.name: CopyIndicator
parts.description: An abstraction of the indicator that shows a copy icon, then an animated checkmark once copied

parts.name: CopyText
parts.description: An abstraction of the indicator that shows "Copy", then "Copied" once copied

parts.name: TriggerWithTooltip
parts.description: An abstraction of the trigger wrapped in a Tooltip that shows the copy status

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Clipboard component.

dataAttributes.name: data-copied
dataAttributes.description: Present when copied state is true.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the clipboard. Useful for composition.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the clipboard

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value to be copied to the clipboard when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the value of the clipboard.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: The function to be called when the value changes

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: The function to be called when the value is copied to the clipboard

props.name: timeout
props.description: The timeout for the copy operation

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
